name: vn.since98/vietnam-payroll
title: Vietnam Payroll and Tax Calculator
description: Vietnam gross/net salary, PIT, social insurance, employer cost and minimum wage, with act numbers.

tools.name: gross_to_net
tools.description: Calculate monthly take-home pay from a gross salary in Vietnam: employee social (8%), health (1.5%) and unemployment (1%) insurance with the ceilings for the date and region, family deductions (15.5 million VND for the taxpayer, 6.2 million per dependent), personal income tax by bracket (5-bracket scale 5% to 35%, or 20% flat for non-residents), net pay, and the employer contributions and total cost. Options: as_of (YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD, default today; month and date are accepted as synonyms), region I-IV or 1-4 (default I), dependents (residents only), residency resident|non_resident, nationality vietnamese|foreigner (foreigner = contract of 12 months or more: no unemployment insurance), insurance_base (if the insured salary differs from gross; not below the regional minimum), union_member (0.5% member fee, default false). Examples: {"gross":30000000}; {"gross":50000000,"dependents":2,"as_of":"2026-08","region":"II"}; {"gross":120000000,"nationality":"foreigner"}.

gross.description: Monthly gross salary in VND (whole number), e.g. 30000000.

as_of.description: Date of the calculation: YYYY-MM (first day of that month) or YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today in Vietnam. Supported from 2026-01; earlier dates are rejected.

month.description: Synonym of as_of (same formats: YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD). Pass only one of as_of, month, date.

date.description: Synonym of as_of (same formats: YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD). Pass only one of as_of, month, date.

region.description: Regional minimum wage zone I, II, III or IV (default I); 1-4 and lower case are accepted. Chosen by the user; there is no locality lookup.

dependents.description: Number of registered dependents (0-20, default 0). Residents only: 6.2 million VND per dependent per month.

residency.description: Tax residency: "resident" (default; progressive scale with deductions) or "non_resident" (flat 20% of gross, no deductions).

nationality.description: "vietnamese" (default) or "foreigner" = foreign citizen with a labour contract of 12 months or more: social and health insurance, no unemployment insurance.

insurance_base.description: Salary used for compulsory insurance, if different from gross. Must not be below the regional minimum wage; capped at the ceilings automatically.

union_member.description: Employee is a trade union member: deduct the 0.5% member fee (default false).

tools.name: net_to_gross
tools.description: Find the gross monthly salary that gives a desired net (take-home) pay in Vietnam, for offers quoted in net. Exact to the dong: target_net and net_difference show the match. Returns the same breakdown as gross_to_net (insurance by fund, deductions, tax by bracket, employer cost). Options: as_of (YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD, default today; month and date are accepted as synonyms), region I-IV or 1-4 (default I), dependents (residents only), residency resident|non_resident, nationality vietnamese|foreigner (foreigner = contract of 12 months or more: no unemployment insurance), insurance_base (if the insured salary differs from gross; not below the regional minimum), union_member (0.5% member fee, default false). Examples: {"net":25000000}; {"net":40000000,"dependents":1,"as_of":"2027-02"}.

tools.name: pit_only
tools.description: Calculate Vietnamese personal income tax on a monthly taxable income that is already known (salary after compulsory insurance and family deductions), with the amount and tax of each bracket of the 5-bracket scale (5%, 10%, 20%, 30%, 35%; thresholds 10, 30, 60, 100 million VND). For non-residents: flat 20% of the income. Use gross_to_net instead when you start from a gross salary. Examples: {"taxable_income":24500000}; {"taxable_income":80000000,"as_of":"2026-03"}; {"taxable_income":50000000,"residency":"non_resident"}.

taxable_income.description: Monthly taxable income in VND: for residents, salary after compulsory insurance and family deductions; for non-residents, the gross salary.

as_of.description: Date of the calculation: YYYY-MM (first day of that month) or YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today in Vietnam. Supported from 2026-01; earlier dates are rejected.

tools.name: employer_cost
tools.description: Calculate what a monthly gross salary costs an employer in Vietnam: social insurance (sickness and maternity 3%, retirement 14%, occupational accident 0.5%), health insurance 3%, unemployment insurance 1% (not for foreigners), the 2% trade union fund, and the total cost; the employee's net pay is included. Options: as_of (YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD, default today; month and date are accepted as synonyms), region I-IV or 1-4 (default I), dependents (residents only), residency resident|non_resident, nationality vietnamese|foreigner (foreigner = contract of 12 months or more: no unemployment insurance), insurance_base (if the insured salary differs from gross; not below the regional minimum), union_member (0.5% member fee, default false). Examples: {"gross":20000000}; {"gross":80000000,"nationality":"foreigner","as_of":"2026-08"}.

tools.name: minimum_wage
tools.description: Return Vietnam's regional minimum wages (monthly and hourly, regions I-IV) in force on a date from January 2026, including the new rates from 1 January 2027, with the unemployment insurance ceiling of each region (20 x the minimum). The region of a workplace is set by the decree's annex of communes; this tool does not look it up. Examples: {}; {"as_of":"2027-02","region":"I"}.

as_of.description: Date of the calculation: YYYY-MM (first day of that month) or YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today in Vietnam. Supported from 2026-01; earlier dates are rejected.

month.description: Synonym of as_of (same formats: YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD). Pass only one of as_of, month, date.

date.description: Synonym of as_of (same formats: YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD). Pass only one of as_of, month, date.

region.description: Optional region I-IV (or 1-4) to single out; all four regions are always listed.

tools.name: withholding_10pct
tools.description: Calculate the 10% personal income tax an organisation withholds from a payment to a resident individual without a labour contract or with a contract under 3 months (freelance, service fees). Threshold per payment: 2 million VND before 1 July 2026, 5 million VND from that date (the effective date of Decree 253/2026/ND-CP); below it nothing is withheld. Caveat on the date: the decree also applies its provisions on residents' salary income to the whole tax year 2026, so the 5 million threshold may be read as applying from 1 January 2026; this is not confirmed, and for January-June 2026 the tool uses 2 million and says so in the notes. Notes cover the commitment-form exemption. Examples: {"amount":8000000}; {"amount":3000000,"as_of":"2026-03-15"}.

amount.description: Amount of one payment in VND (before tax) to a resident without a labour contract or with a contract under 3 months.

as_of.description: Payment date: YYYY-MM (first day of that month) or YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today in Vietnam. Supported from 2026-01; earlier dates are rejected.

month.description: Synonym of as_of (same formats: YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD). Pass only one of as_of, month, date.

date.description: Synonym of as_of (same formats: YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD). Pass only one of as_of, month, date.

tools.name: bhxh_lump_sum
tools.description: Estimate the one-time social insurance payment in Vietnam: 1.5 months of the average insurance salary for each year of contributions before 2014 and 2 months for each year from 2014; leftover months round to half or a full year; under one year it is the amount contributed, capped at 2 months of the average. Pass salary_history (years with monthly insurance salary; each year is indexed with the published BHXH coefficients) or an already indexed average_salary with months_before_2014 and months_from_2014. Eligibility is not checked. Examples: {"salary_history":[{"year":2012,"monthly_salary":5000000},{"year":2013,"monthly_salary":6000000},{"year":2025,"monthly_salary":15000000,"months":7}],"as_of":"2026-09"}; {"average_salary":12000000,"months_before_2014":30,"months_from_2014":50}.

as_of.description: Date of the social insurance agency's decision: YYYY-MM (first day of that month) or YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today in Vietnam. Supported from 2026-01; earlier dates are rejected.

month.description: Synonym of as_of (same formats: YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD). Pass only one of as_of, month, date.

date.description: Synonym of as_of (same formats: YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD). Pass only one of as_of, month, date.

salary_history.description: Simple list of years: {year, monthly_salary, months (default 12)}. Each year is indexed with the published adjustment coefficient; months before 2014 and from 2014 are counted from the years.

average_salary.description: Alternative to salary_history: average monthly insurance salary, ALREADY indexed with the adjustment coefficients.

months_before_2014.description: With average_salary: months of contributions before 2014.

months_from_2014.description: With average_salary: months of contributions from 2014 on.

contributed_amount.description: Under one year of contributions only: the amount actually contributed; if omitted it is estimated at 22% of the salaries.

tools.name: amount_in_words
tools.description: Write a whole number or VND amount (0 to 10^15) in words, in Vietnamese (as on invoices and payment orders: lẻ or linh for a zero tens digit, mốt, tư, lăm; nghìn, triệu, tỷ; optional "đồng chẵn") and in English. Examples: {"amount":1234567891}; {"amount":105,"language":"vi","vi_zero":"linh"}; {"amount":25000000,"vi_chan":true,"capitalize":true}.

currency.description: Append the currency ("đồng" / "dong"). Default true; false gives the bare number.

vi_chan.description: Vietnamese only: end with "đồng chẵn" (an exact amount), as on payment documents. Default false.

vi_zero.description: Vietnamese word for a zero tens digit: "lẻ" (default) or "linh", e.g. 105 = một trăm lẻ năm.

capitalize.description: Capitalize the first letter. Default false.

tools.name: data_info
tools.description: Return the parameters this calculator uses for each period from January 2026 (tax scale, family deductions, base salary, insurance ceilings, regional minimum wages, contribution rates, trade union rates, lump-sum rules, adjustment coefficients) with act numbers and verification status, the rounding rule, what is not included, and the data version. Use when the user asks how current or reliable the figures are. Takes no arguments: {}.
